title: Voice selection
description: Support selection of a specific voice from an optional parameter in the Auritus embed tag, fine-grained markup in content (e.g. per-element voice tags in articles), and interactive voice selectors for all supporting models on the production example pages with rendered audio.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completed: all models with preset voice libraries (Kokoro and Qwen) feature interactive voice selectors with working rendered audio on production example pages. Fine-grained voice markup and embed tag voice parameters are supported and verified with outside-in Gherkin features.
